title: Typed configuration values, secret references only
x-semantic-invariants: kind equals admin configuration namespace; no arbitrary credentials, header maps, scripts or raw SQL.
Endpoint host allowlist, DNS/rebinding/redirect rules are runtime validation; schema HTTPS alone is insufficient.
Config release validates full dependency set, secrets authorization and test freshness/hash before atomic pointer switch.
Storage KMS/CDN, optional SMS/payment/notification/multipart fields must match implemented adapter capability.
Workspace/queue/export limits cannot exceed deployment hard caps or bought entitlements; budget zero disables new paid generation.
Cross-field: autosaveIdleMs<=autosaveMaxMs; minPhotos<=maxPhotos; heartbeatSeconds<leaseSeconds; retry backoffs align to retryLimit; weights sum to1.
textSuggestion is reserved/off in v1; no enabled route until a separate text DTO/provider/billing contract is implemented.
